items.text: Describe the last thing you bought that you did not need.
Talk about a place in your town that has changed since you were a child.
Describe your ideal working day, hour by hour.
Tell me about a meal you cooked for someone else.
Describe a sound you associate with home.
Talk about the last time you were completely absorbed in something.
Tell me about a piece of advice you were given that turned out to be wrong.
Describe a person you only met once but still remember.
Talk about something you own that would be hard to replace.
Tell me about a time you had to explain something complicated to someone.
Describe how you decide whether to trust a news story.
Talk about a habit you have tried to build and how it went.
Tell me about a journey you would happily do again.
Describe the last conversation that changed your mind about something small.
Talk about a job you would be terrible at, and why.
Explain a local custom to someone who has never visited your country.
Describe what you do when you cannot sleep.
Talk about a skill that is disappearing where you live.
Tell me about something you were wrong about for years.
Describe the most useful thing you learned outside school.
Talk about how you would spend a completely free Saturday with no phone.
Explain why you would or would not want to be famous.
Describe a rule at your work or school that you think is unnecessary.
Tell me about a time you helped a stranger.
Talk about the best thing you have read or watched this year.
Describe how prices where you live have changed recently.
Explain how you would teach a child to be patient.
Talk about a decision you postponed for too long.
Describe what a good neighbour does.
Tell me about a time technology made something worse, not better.
Explain your route home as if I had to walk it tonight.
Talk about what you would change about how English is taught.
